_readme: Single source of truth for every dimension. Units are millimetres and degrees.
Do NOT put your measurements here. Put them in params/measured.json as a flat
{"name": value} object (see params/measured.example.json). That file is picked
up automatically by the CLI, rhino/build_all.py and the Grasshopper Params component.
"placeholder": true marks a GUESS that must be measured or decided before it can be
trusted. The build report lists every placeholder that is still in use.
Coordinates: x = right (seen from the driver), y = from the front lip into the dash,
z = up from the Qi pad surface. See docs/measuring.md.

W_top.doc: Cubby inner width just below the roof, measured 10 mm behind the front lip.

W_bottom.doc: Cubby inner width just above the Qi pad surface, measured 10 mm behind the front lip.

W_rear_delta.doc: Width 10 mm in front of the rear wall minus width 10 mm behind the lip, both at shelf height. Negative = cubby narrows toward the rear.

D_cubby.doc: Depth from the front lip to the rear wall, at shelf height.

H_cubby.doc: Height from the Qi pad surface to the roof (lowest point of the roof above the shelf area).

R_rear_corner.doc: Inner radius where the side walls meet the rear wall, seen from above (0 = sharp corner).

W_lip.doc: Narrowest width of the opening at the front lip, at shelf height. Only used to check that the shelf can be inserted flat.

H_ports_top.doc: Highest point of the plugs WITH your real adapters and cables inserted, above the Qi pad. Measure your longest 12 V adapter.

H_ports_bottom.doc: Lowest point of the plug cluster above the Qi pad. Preview only.

X_ports.doc: Lateral centre of the port cluster, from the cubby centreline (+ = right as seen from the driver).

W_ports.doc: Lateral width of the port cluster including plugs, adapters and cables.

D_ports.doc: How far plugs, adapters and cable bends stick out from the rear wall into the cubby.

qi_center_x.doc: Lateral centre of the Qi charging spot (where the phone lies).

qi_center_y.doc: Distance from the front lip to the centre of the Qi charging spot.

phone_length.doc: Phone length incl. case. The phone is assumed to lie crosswise (long side along x).

phone_thickness.doc: Phone thickness incl. case and camera bump.

shelf_height.doc: Height of the shelf's TOP surface above the Qi pad. Decide after measuring H_ports_top and H_cubby.

front_recess.doc: How far the shelf's front edge sits behind the front lip (hides the shelf, looks closer to stock).

rear_gap.doc: Gap between the shelf's rear edge and the rear wall.

side_gap.doc: Gap per side between shelf edge and side wall. Tune with the fit coupon. Negative = interference (press fit). Use the pad thickness if you add felt/foam.

corner_radius_front.doc: Corner radius of the shelf's front corners (cosmetic).

port_notch_width.doc: Width of the cut-out in the shelf's rear edge over the port cluster. 0 disables the notch.

port_notch_depth.doc: How far the notch reaches forward into the shelf, from its rear edge. (The brief's port_notch_height: the notch is a through-cut, so it has a depth, not a height.)

port_notch_offset_x.doc: Lateral shift of the notch centre relative to X_ports.

port_clearance.doc: Minimum air gap the checks demand around plugs and cables.

phone_clearance_min.doc: Minimum free height under the lowest part of the shelf, for the phone on the Qi pad plus room to slide it in and out.

wall_thickness.doc: Thickness of the shelf skirt, ribs and drawer walls.

frame_width.doc: Width of the solid rim around the grid, seen from above.

frame_height.doc: Height of the solid edge band, from the deck top down (skirt). This band is what touches the side walls.

rib_count.doc: Number of stiffening ribs under the deck, running side to side.

cell_size.doc: Opening size of one grid cell (across flats for hex).

bar_width.doc: Width of the web between openings. At least 2 perimeters of your nozzle.

drawer_type.doc: flip = tip-out drawer on a hinge; slide = pull-out drawer on rails.

drawer_width.doc: Outer drawer width. null = derive from the shelf.

drawer_depth.doc: Outer drawer depth. null = derive from the shelf.

drawer_height.doc: Outer drawer height. null = derive from the free space above the shelf.

hinge_position.doc: Pivot axis of the flip drawer. front_bottom = tip-out bin whose top tilts toward the driver.

open_angle.doc: Flip drawer: rotation at the open end stop.

pin_diameter.doc: Hinge pin diameter (printed pin, or 1.75 / 2.85 mm filament). No metal near the Qi coil.

clearance_sliding.doc: Gap per side for sliding fits (drawer on rails). Tune me for your printer.

clearance_hinge.doc: Radial gap for hinge pins and knuckles. Tune me.

clearance_press_fit.doc: Gap for parts that are pressed together. Tune me.

coupon_plate_thickness.doc: Fit coupon: thickness of the flat outline plate (a few layers).

coupon_flange_width.doc: Fit coupon: width of the plate ring, measured inward from the outline. The centre is open.

coupon_rim_width.doc: Fit coupon: wall thickness of the rim that stands on the outline.

coupon_rim_height.doc: Fit coupon: rim height incl. the plate. null = frame_height, so the coupon has the same edge band as the real shelf.

min_bar_width.doc: Warn if grid bars are thinner (default = 2 perimeters at a 0.4 mm nozzle).

min_wall.doc: Warn if walls or rims are thinner.

min_deck_thickness.doc: Warn if the shelf deck is thinner.

arc_segments_per_90.doc: Arc tessellation for the pure-Python STL/3MF export (segments per 90 degrees).
